sections.title: Architecture & operating model
sections.response_text:
Architecture and operating model

Prepared by {auditor_name} ({company}) on {date}.

The assessed system follows the fixed AIC Server enclave model:

  • Control plane: sign-in, privileged access, inventory, Current State Compliance, Assessment Binder, disclosures, and Secure Share
  • Managed machines with agents where enrolled (agentless discovery where supported)
  • System Groups for compliance and binder sampling scope
  • Recorded Remote Access / Connect for assigned workstations

Organization fields fill this instance. They do not redefine the control plane.

Typical deployments run in cloud infrastructure. On-premises partner models may apply.

Hardware-token test fixtures, demo passwords, and seed data are not a production authorization or Met claim.

Security design follows NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5. CMMC packaging does not lower that bar.

An assessor will decide Met after evidence review. This text alone does not mark a control Met.

sections.title: Assessor notes & interview log
sections.response_text:
Assessor sampling notes

Sample Audit LLP - organization packaging view. Assessor-side C3PAO blocks stay blank.

Prepared by {auditor_name} on {date}.

What IT / MSP needs to do

  1. Stand up and operate the fixed enclave model (network, System Groups, agents, crypto custody).
  2. Keep Current State Compliance inventory synced. Remediate or disposition open findings. Re-scan before claiming progress.
  3. Maintain elevation and password-recovery evidence on managed identities only (dedicated service identities only — never personal administrator accounts).
  4. Complete Assessment Binder parameters, apply the matching playbook, regenerate compliance-driven sections, and export for assessor drop. Leave Lead Assessor / Quality Reviewer blank.
  5. Collect operator evidence the product cannot auto-prove. Do not invent Met from narrative alone.

What the C3PAO needs to do

  1. Challenge Met claims that lack scan or artifact support.
  2. Sample endpoints from Current State Compliance and Systems inventory.
  3. Interview the organization or MSP on the assessment boundary.
  4. Complete Lead Assessor and Quality Reviewer sign-offs in C3PAO tooling.
  5. Issue findings from real gaps. Do not treat lab demo controls as production-ready posture.

An assessor will decide Met after evidence review. This text alone does not mark a control Met.
